text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Current time—five p.m. Quota has been
successfully met. Now
engaging in a brief
moment of respite before initiating the
next phase
of training.

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
U-um, excuse me, are you Mihono
Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume jogs over to where
Bourbon is resting.

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I hope I'm not interrupting anything! I
just think it's really
awesome how hard
you're working every day!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No need to be concerned. It appears that
you wish to have a
discussion. How can I
help you?

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Uh, well... I heard you used to only run
sprints, right? It's so cool that
you're able
to run medium-distance now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon stares curiously at the
excited student.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If I may ask, what is the purpose of this
conversation?

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You engaged me in conversation during
my break. Statistically, this
action suggests
an underlying motive.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Common motivations include queries,
transmission of information, and

fact-checking. Which of the above best
suits your purpose?

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text: P-purpose?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the Umamusume struggles to find an
answer, her face begins to
turn pink.

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to talk to you... I'm sorry for
taking up your time! I'll get
going now!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Wait, there's been a misunderstanding...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perplexed, Mihono Bourbon watches the
embarrassed trainee speed
away.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My conversation ended unexpectedly due
to insufficiently defined
"motive"
parameter. Analyzing crash log for source
of error.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have been updating my database with
facial expressions and vocal
inflection
samples, but I am experiencing difficulty
implementing
them in conversations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling bemused, I take a moment to
think. Is this her unique way of
trying to
get better at talking to people?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Certainly. I was prompted by my parents
to improve my "sociability"
functions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The majority of my formative years were
spent training from sunrise to
sunset with
my father. Consequently, I seldom had
opportunities to
interact with my peers.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Once my acceptance to Tracen Academy
was confirmed, my parents
began to
demonstrate great concern over my limited
interpersonal
experiences.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
On multiple occasions, they told me to,
and I quote, "prioritize
engaging with my
friends and classmates."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is true that communicative abilities are
essential for interviews and
fan
engagement. As an Umamusume,
enhancing my "sociability" is
simply
unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I defined a set of parameters related to
"sociability," and have
endeavored to
refine them by engaging in conversation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, the statistics have shown limited
improvement relative to
that of my
physical parameters.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A study showed that questions are
effective starters, but they only
caused my
conversational partner to flee. At this rate,
failure is
certain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can tell her intentions are good, but her
methods leave much to be
desired.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Are her parents this robotic too? I get the
feeling Bourbon is
interpreting their
instructions in an over-rational way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that her parents probably just
want her to enjoy spending
time with
friends. In response, her expression
becomes more puzzled.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, but I am having trouble
comprehending. I have no data
pertaining
to "spending time with friends."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reframing my explanation, I begin talking
about the benefits of
having friends, but
am cut short.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My resting period concluded twenty
seconds ago. I must now return to
my
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without a second to spare, she takes off
down the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon's racing abilities are no
doubt impressive, but her
lack of
connection with the world beyond the race
track concerns me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch her figure dart across the field,
I pray that one day she'll
understand the
meaning behind her parents' words.
